# Priyansh Khandal

> Cybersecurity Researcher, SOC Analyst, and Penetration Tester specializing in Bug Bounty, AI Red-Teaming, Smart Contract Auditing, and NixOS Security.

Priyansh Khandal is an offensive and defensive security researcher. His work spans SOC triage, automated reconnaissance pipelines, AI model security evaluation (red-teaming), EVM smart contract auditing, and declarative OPSEC.

## Primary Surfaces
- [Home Page](https://khandal.tech): Overview, active skills, certifications, and contact options.
- [Projects](https://khandal.tech/projects): Open-source security tools, penetration testing scripts, and system configurations.
- [Researches](https://khandal.tech/researches): Technical writeups on vulnerability research, SIEM triage, and exploit mechanics.
- [Sitemap](https://khandal.tech/sitemap-index.xml): XML sitemap listing all published routes.

## Core Specializations
- **SOC Analysis & SIEM Triage:** Automated incident triage, log analysis, and detection engineering.
- **AI Red-Teaming:** Security evaluations using PyRIT, Garak, and prompt-injection testing datasets.
- **Smart Contract Security:** EVM vulnerability analysis, reentrancy detection, and protocol auditing.
- **Declarative Security:** NixOS system hardening, reproducible security labs, and WireGuard killswitch routing.
